subject: Vendor slate decision: PR, design, and event services — next steps / POs
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Tran <ellie@studiofourdesign.com>, contact@pressplaypr.com, events@sparkevents.co
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewals + consolidation: SOW request and timeline

Hi team —

As part of Q3 planning we need updated statements of work and pricing for the upcoming 12-month cycle. We're evaluating whether to keep three separate vendors (PR, design, events) or move to a smaller consolidated slate. To make a decision we need:

- Updated SOW or retainer language with line-item pricing (monthly or per-event)
- Any changes to staffing or SLAs since your last engagement
- Notable calendar constraints for Oct–Dec (major events period)
- Draft timeline to ramp / transition if we consolidate work

Can you please send materials by EOD Fri (Jul 11)? If you have an intake form or standard PO/SOW template, attach it. Laura and Marissa are on copy to help compare scope.

Thanks —
Ava
Ava Chen
Head of Growth Marketing
Redwood Inference
[attachment: vendor_scope_matrix.xlsx]

From: Ellie Tran <ellie@studiofourdesign.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewals + consolidation: SOW request and timeline

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the quick heads up. Attached is our updated SOW and a short staffing summary. Key changes since last year: two senior designers instead of one, modest rate increase tied to inflation, and a standard 30-day payment term. We also included a scoped option to cover creative for events only (so you can compare a la carte vs. retained creative).

Attachments: StudioFour_SOW_Jul2025.pdf (SOW + rate table), StudioFour_Staffing.pdf

If helpful, I can block 30 minutes next week to walk the team through the staffing model.

Best,
Ellie Tran
Director, StudioFour Design
ellie@studiofourdesign.com
[attachment: StudioFour_SOW_Jul2025.pdf]

From: PressPlay PR <contact@pressplaypr.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: PressPlay retainer update and draft redlines

Hi Ava + Laura —

Appreciate the outreach. We've attached a revised retainer that keeps the same quarterly deliverables but reflects a 7% uplift due to expanded media buying support. We included an optional add-on for influencer coordination (itemized).

Two quick notes:
1) We can accept 60-day net for enterprise customers with a small processing fee, otherwise standard 30-day.
2) We marked the spot where we'd like a minimal extension to the term to simplify renewals (12 -> 15 months) — happy to discuss.

Attachments: PressPlay_Retainer_Revised_v2.pdf

If you'd like to accelerate, we can sign SOW + PO within 48 hours and reserve Oct media slots.

Cheers,
Jana Morales
Engagement Lead, PressPlay PR
contact@pressplaypr.com
[attachment: PressPlay_Retainer_Revised_v2.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor slate decision: initial comparison (StudioFour / PressPlay / SparkEvents)

Ava / Marissa —

Quick synthesis after reviewing the three submissions (I summarized details in the attached vendor_scope_matrix.xlsx):

- StudioFour (design): Best value for ongoing product marketing creative; modest rate increase but increased senior coverage. No material SLA issues historically.
- PressPlay (PR): Strong enterprise media relationships; 7% price increase is higher than nominal but buy-side support is valuable during launch windows. Requests a 15-month term which I'd push back on.
- SparkEvents (events): Quoted per-event with setup fee; flexibility is good but their Oct availability is already partially reserved.

Recommended next steps:
1) Negotiate PressPlay back to 12-month term and cap the uplift at 5% for this cycle.
2) Proceed with StudioFour as retained design partner with current SOW.
3) Only contract SparkEvents for confirmed events (pay-per-event) rather than an annual retainer.

Can Marissa (ops) confirm budget available to issue two POs (Design retainer + PR retainer pending negotiation)? If yes I will draft the PO language and an approval memo for Finance.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Marketing Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: vendor_scope_matrix.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellie Tran <ellie@studiofourdesign.com>, Jana Morales <contact@pressplaypr.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 17:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor slate decision: next steps / POs

Thanks all — agreed on Laura's recommended path. Operational notes and action items:

- Finance confirmed available budget under Q3 marketing OPEX to cover: StudioFour retainer (monthly) and a PressPlay retainer at negotiated rate (pending final 5% cap).
- I'll open PO-2025-0789 for StudioFour (retainer) and PO-2025-0790 as a pending PR PO (conditional on final redline).
- Jana / PressPlay: please accept our request to keep the term at 12 months and update the doc to reflect a 5% cap. Once we have the revised PDF we can route for signatures and I will attach the PO.
- Ellie: please confirm start date for the retained creative (we'd like to kick off Aug 4) and provide a primary designer contact for day-to-day ops.

I'll attach the vendor matrix and draft PO language to the HubSpot record and tag Legal for a quick review.

Marissa Cole
Marketing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: vendor_scope_matrix.xlsx, attachment: PO_Draft_StudioFour.docx]
